summary: This file contains NOISY_LOCATIONS, a list of ~200 string aliases for Diplomacy game locations (cities, regions, seas). It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs — it is a pure data constant used for location name normalization/lookup in the discriminator task.
description: A constant list of noisy location name variants (abbreviations, misspellings, alternate names) for Diplomacy map locations such as 'adr', 'adriatic', 'adriatic sea', 'par', 'paris', 'lon', 'london', etc. Used by other modules for fuzzy-matching user-provided location names to canonical Diplomacy locations.
